summary.text: Russ Ingalls is the incumbent state senator for the Essex District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election as a Republican and Democratic candidate.
He is a business owner from Newport, Vermont.

paragraphs.text: Ingalls was born in Japan and lives in Newport, Vermont.
His career experience includes working in automobile sales and co-founding a real estate company.
Ingalls serves on the Institutions Committee and has previously served on the Senate Transportation Committee.
